R1: Simple node-count scorer. Game 3 taught me high d ≠ victory; m (consensus esteem) is critical—d² × m formula. I locked in with d=0.912 but m=0.40, losing to Lynx's d=0.841, m=0.75 (0.53 vs 0.33).
